# claude-skills

> Three TDD-tested Claude Code skills by Kelonwai: synthetic-user testing for shipped features, model-tier routing for subagent dispatch, and structural quality checks for writing SKILL.md files. Every skill was baseline-tested against agent behavior before release (RED → GREEN → REFACTOR), with production dogfood logs published as receipts.

Install: `npx skills add Kelonwai/claude-skills` — or as a plugin: `/plugin marketplace add Kelonwai/claude-skills`.

## Skills

- [testing-with-synthetic-users](https://github.com/Kelonwai/claude-skills/blob/main/skills/testing-with-synthetic-users/SKILL.md): Multi-round persona-driven testing loop for shipped features — synthetic users with real motivations walk the live deployment until a full round comes back clean. Use when a user-facing feature just shipped and has never been walked end-to-end on production.
- [choosing-agent-models](https://github.com/Kelonwai/claude-skills/blob/main/skills/choosing-agent-models/SKILL.md): Routes each subagent dispatch to the right model tier — taste and judgment to the top tier, research and implementation to mid, mechanical bulk to small; includes a capped-top-tier policy ("the top model thinks; agents do"). Use when fanning work out across multiple agents.
- [writing-good-skills](https://github.com/Kelonwai/claude-skills/blob/main/skills/writing-good-skills/SKILL.md): Seven structural checks for SKILL.md quality — symptom-only descriptions, rules that carry their why, observable artifacts, honest exits, a floor, one memorable line, lean bodies. Use when drafting or fixing a skill, especially one that never auto-triggers.

## Method and receipts

- [README](https://github.com/Kelonwai/claude-skills/blob/main/README.md): What each skill replaces, install options, and the RED/GREEN/REFACTOR method.
- [Dogfood log: testing-with-synthetic-users](https://github.com/Kelonwai/claude-skills/blob/main/feedback/testing-with-synthetic-users.md): Six production runs with observed failure modes and the fixes they drove.
- [Dogfood log: choosing-agent-models](https://github.com/Kelonwai/claude-skills/blob/main/feedback/choosing-agent-models.md): Month-scale audit — 27 loads across 9 projects, a 69% trigger-miss discovery, and the description rewrite that followed.

## Optional

- [Specs](https://github.com/Kelonwai/claude-skills/tree/main/specs): The writing brief each skill was authored against.
